title: Gaja
desc: A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.

title: Moggina Manasu
desc: Renu, Akka, Didi and Chanchala are four friends from college who face several adversities in life. However, they find one way or another to live their life to the fullest.

title: Lakshmi Mahalakshmi
desc: Chandrappa believes that his daughter, Lakshmi, brings good luck and his second daughter, Anita, brings bad luck.

title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a moneylender. However, tables turn when she loses her property, and they fall in love.
